gloss: trailer; preview (of a film or show)

definitions.explanation: A short promotional video shown before a film, TV series, or other media to generate interest. Equivalent to a movie trailer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}{映画|えいが}→新作映画：25174_shinsakueiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予告編|よこくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw the trailer for the new movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{予告編|よこくへん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泣|な}き→泣く：00655_naku⟧そうになった。
examples.english: Just watching this trailer almost made me cry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予告編|よこくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The trailer for next month's release is getting a lot of buzz online.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ (advance notice, preview) and ⟦{編|へん}→〜編：28472_hen⟧ (episode, installment). Refers specifically to promotional video clips for movies, TV shows, anime, and similar media.

USAGE:
The standard Japanese word for what English speakers call a "trailer" or "preview." The English loanword トレーラー is sometimes used in industry contexts, but {予告編|よこくへん} is far more common in everyday Japanese. Often shortened to ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ in casual speech, especially for TV show previews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予告編|よこくへん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to watch a trailer
- {予告編|よこくへん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — a trailer is released
- {予告編|よこくへん}⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ — trailer footage
- ⟦{特報|とくほう}→特報：17800_tokuhou⟧ — teaser trailer (shorter, earlier preview)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予告|よこく}→予告：08379_yokoku⟧ — advance notice; also short for {予告編|よこくへん}
- ⟦{特報|とくほう}→特報：17800_tokuhou⟧ — teaser (shorter, usually the first preview released)
- {次回予告|じかいよこく} — preview of the next episode (TV/anime)
